name: EFORCE
recent: EFORCE 正在推进一项最多占已发行股本 10% 的私募配售，Bursa Securities 已于 2026 年 9 月 30 日批准最多 60,987,800 股配售股份上市。同期，公司有多项企业秘书、注册处及地址变更，并有一名董事辞任。大股东 Wong Thean Soon 及 Asia Internet Holdings 出现持股变动及不再是大股东的通知。
notable: Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 9 月 30 日批准最多 60,987,800 股私募配售股份的上市。
公司秘书、注册处及注册地址出现多项变更。
risks: 私募配售最多发行 10% 新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
大股东 Wong Thean Soon 及 Asia Internet Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 出现不再是大股东的通知。

recent_en: EFORCE is undertaking a private placement of up to 10% of its issued share capital, with Bursa Securities approving the listing of up to 60,987,800 placement shares on 30 September 2026. In the same period, the company saw several changes of company secretary, registrar and address, and a boardroom change. Substantial shareholder Wong Thean Soon and Asia Internet Holdings had changes in shareholding and cessation notices.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% of issued share capital at an issue price to be determined.
Bursa Securities approved the listing of up to 60,987,800 placement shares on 30 September 2026.
Several changes of company secretary, registrar and registered address.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Notices of cessation as substantial shareholder were filed by Wong Thean Soon and Asia Internet Holdings Sdn. Bhd.
